heading: Filed ITR-4 last year? You might need to switch to ITR-3 in AY 2026-27
tldr: Filing ITR-4 for Assessment Year (AY) 2025-26 does not automatically qualify you for ITR-4 in AY 2026-27.
Changes in your income sources or business activities can necessitate a switch to a different ITR form.
ITR-4 is typically for individuals and HUFs opting for presumptive taxation under Sections 44AD, 44ADA, or 44AE.
ITR-3 is for individuals and HUFs with income from a business or profession not opting for presumptive taxation, or those with capital gains, multiple house properties, or directorships.
Always review your financial situation and the specific eligibility criteria for each ITR form before filing your return.
caption:
Did you file ITR-4 last year? Don't just assume you'll use it again next time! Your income might change, meaning you need a different form like ITR-3. This often happens if you start a new business or have different types of earnings. Picking the wrong form can cause problems. Always double-check which ITR form is right for you each year.
